headline: 🔴 Ivanti zero-day chained to root as UTA0576 hits VPNs, 🪟 Microsoft ships record 1,411-flaw Patch Tuesday, 📦 Citrix Fortinet Ivanti fix 29 bugs together, 📄 Nextcloud CODE server exploited via CVE-2026-110447, ☕ ColdFusion ships five criticals at CVSS 10.0, 💻 FBI seizes 187 laptops in NK farm bust

summary: Ivanti disclosed CVE-2026-104935 under active exploitation by UTA0576 with a same-day CISA KEV add while Microsoft shipped a record 1,411-flaw Patch Tuesday led by an exploited Shell zero-day, and Citrix, Fortinet and Ivanti jointly patched 29 bugs. Actively exploited Nextcloud CODE server RCE, a five-critical ColdFusion batch, the FBI seizure of 187 laptops from a North Korean farm network, an OpenAI insider spy-device arrest, and retail breaches at TFG London and a Japanese delivery operator round out a patch-and-intrusion heavy day.
